entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Wednesday that Iosivas tore a ligament in his thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: Dulin (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus Las Vegas.

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Sunday that he's not viewing Aiyuk as an option for the 49ers while the club contends with multiple injuries at receiver, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) didn't practice Thursday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said Wednesday that Kolar (forearm) won't play Sunday in Buffalo but is expected to avoid placement on injured reserve, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Okonkwo (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Seahawks.

entries.name: Cooper Rush
entries.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game versus Green Bay but will serve as the emergency quarterback.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said that Robinson is facing a recovery timeline of 3-to-6 weeks after sustaining a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on injured reserve and is considered week-to-week, per Commanders head coach Dan Quinn.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) returned to practice Friday, Zac Stevens of DNVR Sports reports.

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Taylor (thumb) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hamstring) is "very much in doubt" for Sunday's game against the Colts, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) was not spotted during the open viewing window of Friday's practice, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Williams (hamstring) was a non-participant at Friday's practice.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) didn't practice Friday.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (foot) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: Nwangwu (back) is doubtful for Sunday's game against the Lions, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Friday that Nacua (hip) will be listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Denver, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Mitchell (finger) will be limited in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: O'Connell (personal) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, with head coach Klint Kubiak telling reporters that the tight end's absence from Friday's practice was planned, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest at Denver, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Smith (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Friday.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Head coach Joe Brady said Friday that Moore (shoulder) will be listed as questionable and a game-time decision for Sunday's contest against the Chargers, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (thigh) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) did not participate in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Cleveland, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Warren
entries.summary: Warren (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bengals after being a limited participant in Friday's practice, Alan Saunders of Steelers Now reports.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Chargers.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Mims (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game, according to Alan Saunders of Steelers Now.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

entries.name: Ryan Miller
entries.summary: Miller (hip) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: Bigsby (abdomen) was limited at practice Friday.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: Lance was a limited participant in Friday's practice due to a groin injury and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Bagent (concussion) didn't take part in practice Friday.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot) was a limited participant in Friday's practice.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Legette (knee) was listed as a non-participant at Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (hamstring) is expected to "test his injury" prior to Sunday's game against the Cowboys, and if he suits up he "will likely be on a pitch count," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.
